concordance.aggregation_loss: BEA summary commodities are far broader than HS6 lines. A summary commodity that contains both tariffed and untariffed HS6 products receives an import-weighted average rate, so industry-level exposure is attenuated relative to the true product-level shock, and heterogeneity within a commodity is lost entirely.
